facts.text: All first-year students participate in Messina, a year-long program pairing courses with faculty mentors and Evergreen peer leaders.

sources.title: About | Messina - Loyola University Maryland
sources.quote: Messina is a year-long program for all first-year students at Loyola that fosters connections with faculty, administrators, peer leaders, and Loyola's rich Jesuit tradition of innovation, academic excellence, and community engagement.
